mapper.sql: SELECT rc.receive_confirm_id, rc.distribute_id, rc.ose_id, o.ose_name, rc.confirm_time, rc.confirm_people, rc.receive_status, rc.remark, rc.create_time, rc.update_time, m.total_distribute_quantity FROM ose_breed_seed_receive_confirm rc LEFT JOIN ose_info o ON rc.ose_id = o.ose_id LEFT JOIN breed_seed_distribute_main m ON rc.distribute_id = m.distribute_id
mapper.select: SELECT d.breed_seed_produce_batch_id AS breedSeedProduceBatchId, d.variety_name AS varietyName, d.crop_type AS cropType, d.distribute_quantity AS distributeQuantity FROM breed_seed_distribute_detail d WHERE d.distribute_id = #{distribute_id} ORDER BY d.create_time ASC
